hypotheses.claim: The Pareto-optimal incumbent (round3, obj 16.0504 @188ms) and round5 (16.1239 @123ms) leave substantial unused budget headroom. Scaling ruin-recreate iterations to fill ~500ms and adapting ruin size to instance clustering/capacity-tightness will lower mean objective, especially on the weakest regimes (spatial=clustered, capacity_level=tight, size=100).

next_search_advice.direction: Raise anytime-LNS intensity: adaptively scale ruin-set size and iteration count to consume the full 500ms budget (prior best used only ~188ms), with greedy + regret-2 recreate and simulated-acceptance, emphasizing clustered-spatial and tight-capacity regimes.
